1017.description: A Y-raise with a band, lifting the arms into a Y shape. It trains the delts and upper back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band in front of your thighs with your palms facing inwards.
Keep your arms straight and lift them up and out to the sides, forming a 'Y' shape with your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝内。
保持双臂伸直，将其向上举至两侧，与身体形成“Y”形。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢地将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1081.description: From a plank with feet in straps, you pike the hips up. It hits the abs hard and challenges the shoulders.
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your hips high toward the ceiling.
Roll to an inverted V shape.
Lower back to plank slowly.
Keep your arms straight throughout.

1145.description: A plank with the feet in the straps spread wide like a star, challenging the core and hips.
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Spread your legs wide.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Brace the abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe steadily and do not sag.

1209.description: An overhead cable press where you rotate your torso as you push. It works the shoulders and the core together.
instructions: Set a cable low and stand sideways, holding the handle at your shoulder.
Brace your core and turn slightly toward the cable.
Press the handle overhead while rotating your torso to face forward.
Lower the handle back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

1273.description: An explosive push-up with a clap in mid-air. It builds power in the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your core engaged.
Push through your palms explosively to propel your body off the ground.
While in mid-air, clap your hands together before landing back in the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
弯曲肘部，将身体降低到地面，保持核心参与。
爆发性地推动手掌，将身体推离地面。
在半空中时，拍手，然后回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1337.description: Draping your back over a stability ball to lengthen the spine and stretch the lats.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet forward.
Lean back until your back rests over the ball.
Let your arms fall overhead and relax.
Breathe deeply and let your back open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

1401.description: A muscle-up on a vertical bar, pulling up and then pressing over the top. It trains the lats, chest and triceps in one flowing move.
instructions: Start by hanging from a vertical bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
As you pull yourself up, lean back slightly and bring your elbows towards your sides.
Continue pulling until your chest reaches the bar and your elbows are fully bent.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先悬挂在垂直杆上，手掌背对自己，手臂完全伸展。
启动核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
当你站起来时，稍微向后倾斜，并将肘部移向身体两侧。
继续拉，直到胸部到达杠铃并且肘部完全弯曲。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1465.description: A back extension on a 45 degree bench viewed from the side, targeting the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the roller.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body straight.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise back up until your body is in line, without overarching.
Move slowly and squeeze your glutes at the top.

1529.description: An explosive overhead lift where you dip, drive and catch the bar with locked arms in a quarter squat.
instructions: Rack the bar on your front shoulders with elbows slightly forward.
Dip a short way with your torso upright.
Drive up explosively and punch the bar overhead.
Dip under slightly and catch it with locked arms.
Stand tall, then lower the bar to your shoulders with control.

1593.description: A squat down to a seat and back up. The chair gives you a depth target and builds confidence.
instructions: Stand in front of a chair or bench with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and lower yourself toward the seat.
Lightly touch the seat without relaxing completely.
Keep your chest up and your knees over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand back up.

1657.description: A hammer curl across the body toward the opposite shoulder, version 2. It hits the brachialis and biceps.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps, bringing the dumbbells as close to your opposite shoulder as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌，使哑铃尽可能靠近另一侧的肩膀。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1721.description: A skullcrusher with a reverse grip. It targets the triceps with a different wrist angle.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
Hold the barbell with a reverse grip, palms facing towards your face, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, keeping your elbows in and your wrists straight.
Slowly lower the barbell towards your forehead by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
反握握住杠铃，手掌朝向脸部，双手与肩同宽。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，保持肘部内收和手腕伸直。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到前额，保持上臂静止。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1785.description: Kneeling with your arms reaching forward onto a support lets your chest sink down. It stretches the chest and shoulders.
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench or chair and rest your forearms or hands on it.
Sit your hips back and let your chest drop toward the floor until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1913.description: Kneeling on one knee with the other leg extended and toes up to stretch the hamstring and calf.
instructions: Kneel on one knee and extend the other leg in front, heel on the floor and toes pulled up.
Place your hands on the floor or the front thigh for support.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the extended leg.
Keep the extended knee straight but not locked.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1977.description: Reaching one arm behind your back and pulling it across to stretch the shoulder.
instructions: Stand or sit tall.
Reach one arm behind your back.
Grab that wrist with the other hand and gently pull it across your body.
Keep your shoulders level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2105.description: A backbend style stretch that lengthens the front of the abdomen and hips.
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up through your hands and let your hips sink toward the floor until the lower abdomen stretches.
Keep your hips on the floor and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2297.description: A full-range crunch on a stability ball with hands behind your head. Works the abs through a longer range.
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly curl your upper body forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前弯曲上半身，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2361.description: A side-by-side form check for hip position during a barbell squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and squat down to depth.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips and chest rise together, without the hips shooting up first.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2425.description: A calf raise with a band that builds lower leg strength.
instructions: Sit or stand with the band under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly.
Press up onto your toes against the band.
Pause at the top and squeeze your calves.
Lower your heels slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2745.description: A reverse hyperextension on the smith machine that works the glutes and hamstrings with support from the lower back.
instructions: Lie face down over a bench with your hips at the edge and legs hanging.
Hook your heels under the smith bar if it is set low.
Lift your legs by extending the hips until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

2809.description: A split squat with a barbell on your back, a second variation. Builds single leg strength and balance.
instructions: Rest the barbell across your upper back and step into a split stance.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Press through your front foot to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

2873.description: A seated Pilates stretch that rounds the spine forward to lengthen the back and hamstrings.
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Draw your belly in and flex your feet.
Curl forward one vertebra at a time, reaching over an imaginary ball.
Hold for a breath at the bottom.
Roll back up to tall sitting and repeat.

2937.description: A rollout on a stability ball with a rounded back that trains the abs hard.
instructions: Kneel in front of a stability ball with forearms on top.
Round your back slightly and tuck your pelvis.
Roll the ball forward by extending your arms.
Pull it back using your abs.
Keep your hips from sagging and move slowly.

3001.description: A bodyweight squat focused on where your knees travel, helping you learn to track them over your toes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Brace your core and lift your chest.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower into a squat.
Push your knees out so they follow the line of your toes.
Go down as deep as feels controlled.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.

3129.description: A shoulder blade drill where you pull the blades together and then spread them apart. It improves control of the scapulae.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your arms forward at shoulder height.
Pull your shoulder blades together behind you.
Hold for a moment.
Then push your hands forward and let the blades spread apart.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Keep your neck relaxed and your ribs down.

3193.description: A hamstring exercise where you lift your torso from a face-down position on a glute-ham bench. It strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Adjust the glute-ham raise machine to fit your body.
Position yourself face down on the machine with your ankles secured.
Place your hands on your chest or cross them over your chest.
Engage your hamstrings and glutes to lift your upper body up towards the ceiling.
Continue lifting until your body is in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整臀肌提升机以适合您的身体。
将自己面朝下放在机器上，固定脚踝。
将双手放在胸前或交叉在胸前。
调动腿筋和臀肌，将上半身抬向天花板。
继续抬起，直到身体从头部到脚后跟成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3257.description: One-arm circles to warm up the shoulder joint.
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm out to the side.
Make slow circles, gradually larger.
Reverse the direction.
Switch arms.

3321.description: A band version of the reverse fly that works the back of your shoulders and upper back, handy for posture.
instructions: Hold the band in both hands in front of you with arms straight.
Stand tall with a soft knee bend and your core tight.
Pull your hands apart and out to the sides at shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap back.

3385.description: A seated machine press that loads the thighs and glutes with a stable path.
instructions: Sit on the machine and set your back firmly against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety and lower the weight until your knees bend to about 90 degrees.
Press through your whole foot to extend your legs.
Stop just short of locking your knees.
Lower under control and repeat.

3449.description: A seated rotation with a dumbbell for the obliques.
instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted.
Move with control.

3513.description: A shoulder and chest stretch holding a band behind the back. It opens the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall holding a band behind your back with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and your hands wide.
Lift your hands away from your back gently.
Keep your chest open and your ribs down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

3577.description: Combine a lunge with a kettlebell clean and overhead press for a full body strength move.
instructions: Start standing with a kettlebell hanging in one hand.
Step back into a lunge while cleaning the bell to your shoulder.
Rise from the lunge and press the bell overhead.
Lower the bell to the shoulder, then to your side.
Alternate legs and switch hands after the set.

3641.description: A kneeling step combined with a weighted swing. It trains the shoulders and core.
instructions: Start in a kneeling position with your knees hip-width apart and your back straight.
Hold a weight in each hand, with your arms extended straight down in front of you.
Engage your core and swing the weights up and overhead, keeping your arms straight.
Lower the weights back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从跪姿开始，膝盖分开与臀部同宽，背部挺直。
每只手各握一个重物，双臂在身前笔直向下伸展。
启动你的核心肌群，将重物向上举过头顶，保持手臂伸直。
将重量放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

3705.description: A burpee without the push-up and jump. You drop to a plank and spring back to your feet for a steady conditioning move.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Kick your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Stand up and repeat at a steady pace.

3769.description: A squat where the leg steps diagonally behind and across the body, like a curtsy. It trains the glutes and outer thighs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step diagonally behind and across your body with your right foot, crossing it behind your left leg.
Bend both knees as if you were curtsying, lowering your body towards the ground.
Keep your torso upright and your weight on your front foot.
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping diagonally behind and across your body with your left foot.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向斜后方跨出一步，跨过身体，交叉在左腿后面。
弯曲双膝，就像行屈膝礼一样，将身体降低到地面。
保持躯干直立，将体重放在前脚上。
推动前脚返回起始位置。
在另一侧重复，用左脚斜向后方跨过身体。

3833.description: A hang from a hangboard using an open hand grip. It builds finger strength with less strain on your joints.
instructions: Grip the edge with fingers extended and a slight arch.
Step off and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders engaged.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down and rest before the next hang.

3961.description: A lunge sequence that steps forward, to the side and then back with the same leg. It trains the legs and hips from three directions and challenges your balance.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together and hands on your hips.
Step one foot forward into a lunge, then push back to standing.
Step the same foot out to the side, sit back into the hip, then return to center.
Step the same foot backward into a lunge and push back to standing.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes, then switch legs after your set.

4025.description: A gentle band warm-up that pulls the arms down from overhead to prepare the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Stand tall and hold the band overhead with both hands, a little wider than shoulder width.
Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Pull your hands down in front of you toward your chest.
Return slowly overhead keeping tension.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps.

4089.description: A wide stance squat holding a kettlebell between your legs, working your glutes, inner thighs and quads.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulders and toes turned out, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips down and back, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

4153.description: A push up where one arm does most of the work while the other extends out to the side. It builds unilateral chest and arm strength.
instructions: Start in a wide push up position with hands well outside your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Shift your weight to one arm and bend that elbow while the other arm stays straight.
Lower your chest toward the bent arm side.
Push back up and shift to the centre.
Alternate or complete reps on one side, then switch.

4217.description: A lat pulldown with a wide handle that keeps your palms facing each other. It builds back width with less wrist strain.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and lock your thighs under the pads.
Grab the wide neutral-grip handles with straight arms.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Pause, then let the bar rise slowly.
Do not swing your torso.

4345.description: A biceps curl on an incline bench with a cable and a narrow grip. It keeps constant tension and a deep stretch.
instructions: Lean back on an incline bench in front of a low cable with a straight bar.
Grip the bar close together with palms up.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders, upper arms still.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

4409.description: A walking lunge with the barbell in a front rack, challenging the legs, balance and core.
instructions: Rest the barbell across your front shoulders with elbows high.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg through into the next step.
Keep walking, alternating legs, with an upright torso.

4473.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the deep glutes (piriformis). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your deep glutes (piriformis) while sitting on the floor with your ankle over the opposite knee.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4601.description: A lying rotation that opens the chest and mid back, good for thoracic mobility and tight shoulders.
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked, arms straight in front of you.
Keep your knees together and lift the top arm up and over.
Rotate your chest open toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Return the arm and repeat, then switch sides.

4665.description: Reaching your arms overhead and clapping to warm up the shoulders. It improves shoulder mobility and activation.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides and overhead.
Clap your hands above your head.
Lower your arms back to your sides with control.
Keep your ribs down and move smoothly through your reps.

4729.description: A weighted bench dip with your feet raised on a second bench, which makes the triceps work harder.
instructions: Place two benches facing each other, hands on one and heels on the other.
Set a dumbbell on your lap and keep your legs straight.
Lower your hips by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Keep your chest up and your elbows pointing back.
Press up until your arms are straight again.

4793.description: An explosive one-leg hip thrust where you jump your hips off the floor. It trains glute power.
instructions: Sit with your upper back on a bench and one foot planted.
Lift the other leg.
Drive up through your heel and thrust your hips explosively.
Let your hips leave the floor briefly.
Land softly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

4857.description: A push press with the bar behind the neck. It builds overhead power.
instructions: Hold a barbell on your upper back with a wide grip.
Dip your knees slightly.
Drive up explosively and press overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders.

4921.description: A row with the rings pulled toward your face, higher than a normal row. It builds the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Hold the rings and lean back with a straight body.
Pull the rings toward your forehead.
Flare your elbows out and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

4985.description: Floor glute ham raise where a band helps you come back up. It builds the hamstrings and glutes with a manageable load.
instructions: Anchor a band at head height and loop it around your chest or hold it to your chest.
Kneel with your feet held firmly under a stable object.
Lower your torso forward slowly with a straight line from knees to head.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings and glutes, using the band to help.
Keep your hips extended throughout.

5049.description: Face down, lift your chest and legs with arms in a W. It builds the lower back and upper back.
instructions: Lie face down with elbows bent and hands by your head.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lift your chest, arms and legs slightly off the floor.
Pull your shoulder blades together and hold for a second.
Lower slowly.

5241.description: A classic reverse hyper lift on a bench, raising the legs behind you. It trains the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down over a bench with your hips at the edge.
Hold the bench and keep your legs hanging down.
Lift your legs behind you until your body is straight.
Pause and squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly without swinging.

5369.description: Row a cable handle with one arm from a kneeling position. Builds the lats and mid back.
instructions: Kneel facing the cable stack and grab the handle with one hand.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

5497.description: Plank variation where you pass a dumbbell under your body from hand to hand, challenging core stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell beside one hand and feet wide.
Brace your core and keep hips level.
Reach the free hand under your body and grab the dumbbell.
Pass it across to the other side and place it down.
Repeat, alternating sides.

5817.description: A gentle shoulder rotation lying on your side with a light dumbbell. It strengthens the rotator cuff for joint stability.
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench with a light dumbbell in the top hand.
Keep your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked to your side.
Rotate your forearm upward, keeping your elbow still.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and switch sides after your set.

5881.description: Walk on hands and feet with your belly facing up, a playful drill that fires up the glutes, triceps and core.
instructions: Sit on the floor, place your hands behind you and lift your hips off the ground.
Keep your hips high and your core braced.
Step with opposite hand and foot to move forward.
Walk for several steps, then go backward.
Keep your head neutral and your arms steady.

6073.description: A front raise with bottles for the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise both arms straight in front to shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause.
Lower slowly without swinging.

6137.description: A standing drill where you squeeze your shoulder blades together with no weight. It wakes up the mid back and helps posture.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out in front or at your sides.
Keep your arms mostly straight.
Pull your shoulder blades back and together.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Release slowly.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders to your ears.

6265.description: An alternating standing curl with an overhand grip. It builds the forearms.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms.
Keep your wrists straight.

6329.description: A deep split squat with a barbell on your upper back that builds strong quads and glutes and tests your balance.
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step into a long split stance.
Brace your core and keep your torso tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor under control.
Press through your front foot to stand up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

7417.description: Sit-up with arms overhead and calves on a bench for a longer lever on the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Extend your arms overhead.
Curl your torso up, keeping your arms by your ears.
Reach toward your knees.
Lower slowly.

8505.description: A diagonal chopping and lifting pattern from a kneeling position that trains the obliques and shoulders.
instructions: Kneel on both knees and hold one dumbbell with both hands beside one hip.
Keep your hips square.
Twist and lift the dumbbell diagonally up across your body.
Reverse the path back down to the hip.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

8633.description: A seated overhead press without equipment that trains the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your hands to shoulder height with elbows bent.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to your shoulders under control.

9849.description: A side plank where you open and close your top knee. It works the outer hips and the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your side in a side plank, supported on your forearm with knees bent.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line.
Keep your feet together and open your top knee upward.
Close it under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

9977.description: A calm lying breathing drill that focuses on belly breathing. It helps you relax and learn core control.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands on your belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Feel your belly rise under your hands.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Let your belly lower gently.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes.

10041.description: A side plank with a dumbbell added, usually held in the top hand, to make the hold harder.
instructions: Lie on your side, elbow under your shoulder, with a dumbbell in your top hand.
Lift your hips into a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the dumbbell either at your side or pointing to the ceiling.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower with control, then switch sides.
Keep your hips high and don't rotate.

10553.description: Swing a resistance band from overhead down in front of you in a chopping motion. It builds powerful chest and core strength.
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and hold the handles with both hands.
Stand with a staggered stance and your arms raised.
Pull the handles down and forward in a controlled hit.
Brace your core as you finish.
Return slowly and repeat.

10745.description: A seated hip mobility drill where you sweep one leg in a half circle. It warms up the hips.
instructions: Sit tall on the floor with hands behind you for support.
Lift one leg slightly with the knee straight.
Draw a half circle with your foot from one side to the other.
Keep your torso steady.
Repeat for the reps.
Switch legs.

10873.description: A crunch with a dumbbell held overhead. The extra load and long lever challenge your abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold one dumbbell upright with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, driving the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly and repeat.

10937.description: Rotating the shoulder against a wall. It gives gentle mobility and awareness.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your forearm against it.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up and down against the wall.
Keep your shoulder relaxed.
Switch arms after your reps.

11257.description: A seated row with the handle pulled toward your upper chest. It targets the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Sit at a cable station with the pulley set high and grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles toward your upper chest, elbows flaring slightly.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to full arm extension.

0057.description: Lie back and bend only at the elbows to lower the bar, then extend again. A direct triceps builder.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the barbell towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
正手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到前额。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0121.description: An upright row with the barbell pulled toward the chin. Works the delts and traps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Let the barbell hang in front of your thighs, arms fully extended.
Keeping your core engaged and back straight, exhale as you lift the barbell straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale as you slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
让杠铃悬挂在大腿前面，双臂完全伸展。
保持核心收紧，背部挺直，呼气，将杠铃向上举至下巴，用肘部引导。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0185.description: A cable fly done lying on a flat bench. The arms open in a wide arc and close again, working the chest through a deep stretch.
instructions: Attach the handles to the cables and lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the handles with your palms facing each other and your arms extended straight above your chest.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then squeeze your chest muscles to bring your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将手柄连接到电缆上，平放在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上。
手掌相对，握住手柄，双臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，将手臂以宽弧线向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0313.description: The standard hammer curl with the palms facing in. It trains the brachialis, biceps and forearms.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
This will be your starting position.
Now, keeping the upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Then, inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干。
保持肘部靠近躯干，并旋转手掌，直到手掌朝前。
这将是您的起始位置。
现在，保持上臂静止，呼气并卷曲哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
然后，吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复建议的重复次数。

0377.description: Bent over, you row dumbbells with elbows flared out. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Extend your arms straight down towards the floor, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将手臂伸直向下伸向地板，肘部稍微弯曲。
将哑铃向两侧举起，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0505.description: A crunch with legs that split apart like a jumping jack while lying down. It trains the abs and keeps the legs working.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead and legs together.
Lift your shoulders and legs as you crunch up.
Open your legs wide in a split while your hands reach forward.
Bring the legs back together as you lower.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Repeat at a smooth, steady pace.

0569.description: Lying on your back with heels on a ball, you curl it toward your hips. It works the hamstrings and core together.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball and legs straight.
Press your hips up so your body forms a line.
Pull the ball toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Keep your hips lifted throughout.
Pause at the top.
Roll the ball back out slowly.

0633.description: A face-down neck bridge that strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck. Start gently and keep the load light.
instructions: Kneel on a mat and lean forward so the top of your head rests lightly on the floor.
Place your hands on the floor for support.
Take some weight through your neck by rocking forward and back slowly.
Keep your movements small and controlled.
Return to the start and rest between sets.
Never bounce and keep most weight on your hands at first.

0697.description: Lying on your back, you curl your heels toward your glutes. A body weight move for the hamstrings.
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat or bench with your legs extended.
Place your hands by your sides or under your glutes for support.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the ground, bringing your thighs towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在垫子或长凳上，双腿伸展。
将双手放在身体两侧或臀部下方以获得支撑。
弯曲膝盖，将脚抬离地面，将大腿靠近胸部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0761.description: A row with a narrow grip on the smith machine, pulling toward the torso. It works the mid back and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your chest up as you pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，握距略窄于肩宽。
当您将手柄拉向身体时，保持背部挺直，挺胸，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0953.description: Fold forward and slide your hands under your feet. It stretches the hamstrings, calves and back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and fold forward with a long spine.
Slide your hands under your feet with palms up, toes on your fingers.
Pull gently to deepen the stretch while keeping your knees slightly soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
